outcome: Sensitivity of oral glucose challenge test (OGCT)
cohort: 700 pregnant Omani women attending antenatal clinics in their first trimester
finding: Obesity during pregnancy is associated with increased risks of cesarean section, gestational hypertension, macrosomia, and miscarriage.
mod_finding: Obesity is associated with an increased risk of cesarean section, especially elective cesarean.
birth_weight: Birth weight data was collected and correlated with BMI, specifically mentioning macrosomia risk.
